title: You're Alone at a Mountain Weather Station. Something Knocks at 3 AM.
description:
The last man who worked here left three rules. Rule two: if you hear knocking, do not answer.

Thirty days alone at Kestrel Ridge Weather Station, 3,000 meters up a mountain. A storm, a generator, a logbook... and three knocks at 3 AM.

An original animated survival mystery from Rules Left Behind.

Carbon monoxide is real: if you use a generator or fuel-burning heater, keep exhausts clear and use a working CO alarm.
